zh.explain: 如果目前有疾病或官司，也不必忧虑，求财也能轻易获得。正如猴子挣脱了锁链，回到山洞自由游乐。
divination: 摆脱了困境，除却了烦恼之事，暂且把心放宽，等到机会来临，就可走上正道。
zh.summary: 此卦猿猴脱锁之象。所祈求之事刚开始会有些困难，之后能顺利缓解。

verse: Fret not of illnesses and disagreements before you,
Riches and resources are there for your picking.
Like a monkey that’s freed of its golden chain,
Roaming freely among mountains and caves.
interpretation: Get rid of your worries and troubles.  Broaden your mind.
Wait for the right time and the right path will open for you.
meaning: A monkey escaped from its chain.  Things will get easier once you have overcome the difficulties and hardships.
en.explain: If you are sick or involved in a lawsuit, there is no need to worry, even wealth can easily be obtained. Just like a monkey that is free from its chain, it is able to return, roam freely in its mountain cave.
divination: Once your worries and troubles are overcome, open your mind and wait for the right opportunity to come, then you can embark on the right path to success.
items: Wait for a change to succeed
Put in best effort and work harder
Do good & pray for blessing, protection

notes: zh items: key printed as 畜养动物; extra item 迁徙搬家 present. en uses a curly apostrophe in 'that’s'. Double spaces after periods in en interpretation/meaning kept as printed.
